import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    k = params[8]; w = params[9]
    g = params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*x**2 + params[3]*np.sin(x) + params[4]*x*np.exp(-x)
    f = params[5]*np.exp(-k*t) + params[6]*np.cos(w*t) + params[7]*np.sin(w*t)
    return g + f
